name: game-studio-arcade
description: A basement arcade cabinet that builds its own games. The Studio makes the games; the Arcade plays them.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/test/coin.test.mjs scripts/test/maker.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/lib.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/connect.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/update.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/link.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/netwatch.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/boot-wait.test.mjs scripts/cabinet-card/test/card.test.mjs scripts/virtual-cabinet/test/groq-key.test.mjs scripts/test/twin.test.mjs
